spells.name: Summon Hyshian Twinstones
spells.effect: Set up a **Hyshian Twinstones** endless spell wholly within 6" of the caster
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Hyshian Twinstones** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Summon Rune of Petrification
spells.effect: Set up a **Rune of Petrification** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Rune of Petrification** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

spells.name: Summon Sanctum of Amyntok
spells.effect: Set up a **Sanctum of Amyntok** within the target’s combat range, visible to the caster and more than 3" from all enemy units. A **Sanctum of Amyntok** has 3 parts that must be set up with the tip of each part touching the tip of another part so that the three parts form a ring with the target inside.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanctum of Amyntok** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Lumineth Realm‑lords Wizard^^** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **^^Lumineth Realm‑lords Infantry Hero^^** wholly within 12" of them and more than 3" from all other units and terrain features to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
